description: Fix multiple bugs found in pass 6: Express 5 listen signature, error message leakage, PIN lockout bypass on DB failure, useCollection stale optimistic data on error, and unstable useCallback deps in useAutocompleteFocusBoundary
steps: 1. Fix artifacts/api-server/src/index.ts: Express 5 app.listen() does NOT pass an error to the callback. The callback is invoked with no arguments when the server starts. Errors must be caught via the 'error' event on the returned http.Server. Change from `app.listen(port, (err) => {...})` to `const server = app.listen(port, () => { logger.info({port}, 'Server listening'); }); server.on('error', (err) => { logger.error({err}, 'Error listening on port'); process.exit(1); });`

2. Fix api/_lib/http.ts serverErrorResponse: The function currently exposes `error.message` directly to clients in all environments. In production this can leak internal details (file paths, DB connection info from error messages). Change to return a generic message in production and only include the actual message in development: `message: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? message : 'Internal server error.'`

3. Fix api/_lib/pinAttemptStore.ts getPinAttemptRecord: When the database is unreachable, this returns {failures: 0, lockedUntil: null} which silently resets any active lockout. An attacker who can cause transient DB failures gets unlimited PIN attempts. Instead, on DB error, return a fail-closed response that either preserves the last known state or blocks access. Change the catch block to return {failures: Infinity, lockedUntil: Date.now() + 60000} so that a DB outage results in a temporary block rather than a bypass. Also update the PinAttemptRecord interface to allow Infinity for failures.

4. Fix src/hooks/useCollection.ts performMutation: When the mutation throws (rejected by server as conflict/unauthorized), mutationsInFlightRef is decremented and isSubmitting is cleared but `data` remains set to the optimistic value. The caller gets an error but the UI shows stale optimistic state. In the catch path (before re-throw), call `refresh()` to trigger a re-read of the actual server state so the UI recovers to truth.

5. Fix src/components/ui/lib/useWorkspaceAutocompleteDismiss.ts useAutocompleteFocusBoundary: The useCallback for onFocusCapture and onBlurCapture reference `options?.onFocusStateChange` and `options?.shouldSkipClose` in deps. When options is an inline object, these property accesses return unstable function references, causing the callbacks to be recreated on every render. Destructure the options at the top of the hook and use useRef to store the callbacks so deps stay stable.
acceptance_criteria: bun x tsc --build passes with no errors
Express 5 server in artifacts/api-server/src/index.ts correctly handles listen errors via server.on('error', ...)
serverErrorResponse does not expose internal error messages in production
getPinAttemptRecord fails closed (denies access) when the database is unreachable
useCollection re-fetches server state after a failed mutation instead of leaving stale optimistic data
useAutocompleteFocusBoundary callbacks have stable references when options object is recreated
verification: Run `bun x tsc --build` and confirm it passes cleanly
findings: All 5 fixes applied and verified with bun x tsc --build (clean pass, exit 0). No pre-existing test failures encountered.
